chunks: When dawn rises, perform the morning prayer, then stand there at the foot of the mountain.
It is recommended for the one performing Hajj for the first time to tread upon al-Mashʿar with his foot, or with his mount if he is riding.
Allah, the Exalted, says: "Then when you depart from ʿArafāt, remember Allah at al-Mashʿar al-Haram, and remember Him as He has guided you, though before that you were surely among those astray."
Let your standing be while you are in a state of ghusl, and say:

"O Allah, Lord of al-Mashʿar al-Haram, Lord of the Corner and the Station, Lord of the Black Stone and Zamzam, and Lord of the appointed days, free my neck from the Fire, expand for me from Your halal provision, and avert from me the evil of the sinful among jinn and humankind and the evil of the sinful among Arabs and non-Arabs. O Allah, You are the best sought, the best called upon, and the best asked; and every visitor has a gift, so make my gift in this place of mine that You overlook my stumble, accept my excuse, pardon my sin, make taqwa my provision from this world, and return me successful, prospering, and answered, with the best of what any of Your delegation and the pilgrims of Your Sacred House returns with."

And supplicate to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, abundantly for yourself, your parents, your child, your family, your wealth, and your believing brothers and believing sisters, for it is a noble and tremendous station, and standing in it is an obligation. Then when the sun rises, confess your sins to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, seven times and ask Him for tawbah seven times. And when the people become many at Jamʿ and it becomes constricted for them, they go up to al-Maʾzimayn.

key_terms.التَّقْوَى: God-conscious piety made a spiritual provision for one's journey in life
key_terms.الصَّرُورَةِ: a person performing hajj for the first time
key_terms.الْأَيَّامِ الْمَعْلُومَاتِ: the appointed well-known days of hajj rites
key_terms.الْغَدَاةَ: the morning prayer, meaning salat al-fajr in this context
key_terms.الْمَأْزِمَيْنِ: the two narrow mountain passes near Muzdalifah
key_terms.الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ: the sacred site at Muzdalifah where pilgrims stand in remembrance of Allah during hajj
key_terms.غُسْلٍ: ritual bath performed for taharah before the standing

ai.seo_question: What should be recited and done while standing at al-Mashʿar al-Haram during hajj?
ai.summary: This passage outlines the rites and supplications associated with standing at al-Mashʿar al-Haram during hajj. It combines legal guidance, Qur'anic remembrance, ritual purity, and a comprehensive du'a seeking forgiveness, protection, halal provision, and taqwa.
